verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a WooCommerce point-of-sale for in-person selling, let alone one that shares catalog, inventory and customers with the online store. The iOS/Android mobile app is described only as a store-management tool. Square appears only as an online payment gateway, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can sell in person with a point-of-sale that shares the same catalog, inventory, and customers as my online store
